hook.name: UhoodnamesFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-adjusted fee hook for Uhoodnames launchpad pools that charges 1–5% ETH fees on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta). Fees scale with the previous swap's tick movement and are forwarded directly to a per-pool fee recipient. Exact-output swaps are rejected; only exact-input swaps are supported.
